historical_record.description: The Hilton hotel tower, by Stone, Marraccini & Patterson with John Carl Warnecke.
The downtown Airlines Bus Terminal stood on this corner of O'Farrell and Taylor until it was demolished in 1979, leaving the lot vacant.
